name: U-2 Dragon Lady
summary: Single-engine high-altitude reconnaissance aircraft with glider-like wings, flying above 70,000 ft from Beale AFB; retirement repeatedly proposed but blocked by Congress.

wings: Extremely long, narrow, straight wings like a glider
Large sensor pods often mounted mid-wing
engines: Small intakes on each side of the fuselage behind the cockpit
fuselage: Long slim fuselage, usually all black
Bicycle landing gear with detachable 'pogo' outrigger wheels under the wings
Single-seat canopy (TU-2S has a raised second cockpit); often a long dorsal antenna fairing
tail: Horizontal tail mounted low on the rear fuselage

tellTales: Glider-like, extremely long straight wings on a jet
All-black finish with large pods mid-wing
Small side intakes behind a single-seat cockpit

confusedWith.howToTell: The U-2 has a cockpit canopy, a jet engine and a single fin; the MQ-9 is a windowless drone with a rear propeller and a Y-shaped tail.

usCount.source: Air & Space Forces Magazine / House Appropriations FY2027 defense bill reporting (20 U-2S, 3 TU-2S)
